algolia.search.facets.facet.dialog.prope: Facets let you create categories on a select group of attributes so that users can refine their search. "Refinement": List Filters the dataset based on facet values, "Hierarchical Menu": Creates a navigation menu based on a hierarchy of facet attributes. It’s commonly used for categories with subcategories, "Menu": Extensionss a menu that lets the user choose a single value for a specific attribute, "Numeric Menu": Extensionss a list of numeric filters in a list. Those numeric filters are pre-configured when creating the widget, "Range Slider": Extensionss a slider that lets the user choose between the min and/or the max of the range, "Range Input": Allows a user to select a numeric range using a minimum and maximum input, "Rating Menu": Lets the user refine search results by clicking on stars. The stars are based on the selected attribute.
